headline: Nigerian Banking Stocks Rally 79% Year-to-Date Despite Low Valuations
summary: The NGX Banking Index has surged 79% year-to-date, though leading Nigerian lenders continue to trade at significant valuation discounts relative to underlying assets.
why: Nigerian commercial banks are key drivers of liquidity on the Nigerian Exchange; persistent asset discounts reflect sovereign equity risk premiums.

impacts.name: Nigerian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Surging investor buying pushed banking equities up 79% year-to-date.

why_moved: Sustained buying interest lifted the NGX Banking Index by 79% year-to-date, even as valuations remain historically depressed.
